description: Build a multi-lesson training/course surface as ONE properly-linked page with real in-app tab navigation between lessons — prefer this over build_multi_page_surface for training/course content specifically: that tool produces N independent pages with NO links between them (you must present the list yourself); this tool produces one page where lessons are real, clickable tabs. Zero sizing/estimation judgment required — give it your lessons, it handles composition and navigation.

lessons.description: Array of {heading, content} lessons — each becomes its own tab

content.description: Raw text content for this lesson

renderer_url.description: Your deployed renderer /exec URL (optional; defaults to BYO)

name: emit_training_runbook

clipboard.description: Optional ready-made copy commands for the URL (linux, macos, windows) plus a note.

payload.description: The compiled A2UI v1.0 createSurface payload.

required_catalogs.description: Catalog URIs the payload needs (base catalog first).

size.description: Present when the URL is large: url_length, warning and recommendation.

url_length.description: Characters the URL is once the gas/ stable link is followed.
